defects.title: internalRxnBool is not assigned when every reaction has an RXN file
defects.trigger: model = createModel({'R1'}, {''}, {'h2[c] -> 2 h[c]'}, 'printLevel', 0); folder with R1.rxn; [m, r, i] = findRXNFiles(model, folder)
defects.observed: R2025a: MATLAB:unassignedOutputs 'Output argument "internalRxnBool" (and possibly others) not assigned a value ...'; two outputs work
defects.expected: n x 1 internalRxnBool as findRXNFilesPlain returns

notes: Reproduction: d = tempname; mkdir(d); fclose(fopen(fullfile(d, 'R1.rxn'), 'w')); model = createModel({'R1'}, {''}, {'h2[c] -> 2 h[c]'}, 'printLevel', 0); [m, r, i] = findRXNFiles(model, d). Confined to the three-output form with every reaction mapped; caller checkRXNFiles: lead to judge whether it reaches it. Line 31-32 (duplicate file names in one dir listing) would be unreachable anyway. findRXNFilesPlain (this slice, TESTED) is the corrected copy.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: internalRxnBool is assigned only inside if any(~rxnRXNBool), lines 45-60; checkRXNFiles asks for three outputs, so it reaches the defect whenever every reaction has an RXN file)

defects.title: Exchange reactions without an RXN file get NaN, and the first reaction gets 0
defects.trigger: model = createModel({'R1','EX_h2','R3'}, {'','',''}, {'h2[c] -> 2 h[c]', 'h2[c] <=> ', 'h[c] -> q[c]'}, 'printLevel', 0); folder with only R1.rxn (H2 -> H + H); findBondsBrokenAndFormed(model, {'R3'; 'EX_h2'; 'R1'}, folder, 0)
defects.observed: R2025a: [0 NaN 1]; line 223 ismember(i, exIdx) with logical exIdx

notes: Reproduction: the RXN file R1.rxn was written with a small helper (2-line counts '  1  2', substrate H2 atoms mapped 1, 2 with one bond '  1  2  1', products H (map 1) and H (map 2)); order {'EX_h2'; 'R3'; 'R1'} gives the right [0 NaN 1] by accident, {'R1'; 'R3'} gives [1 NaN]. Also seen (not recorded as a separate defect): with printLevel > 0 the NaN substrate mass of a missing reaction (line 233) is overwritten by 0 at line 239 (same in findEnthalpyChange 273/279). Caller: generateChemicalDatabase.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 223 tests ismember(i, exIdx) with exIdx logical, so the loop index is compared with 0/1 values instead of selecting the exchange reactions)
